Although it is also listed by the FDA as a "Substance added to Food," this likely refers to tightly regulated, very low quantities, and the chemical may still pose hazards under different conditions.
Q3: This chemical is extensively characterized, with 66,000 literature references, a well-defined molecular formula, and robust toxicological evaluations by both EPA IRIS and PPRTV, supported by 95 toxicity records.
